prompt: For each server in serverTable, ping it and email admin if down

steps.description: Create a memory table to hold server data.
Get the total number of rows in the serverTable.
Loop through each server in the serverTable.
Exit the loop when all servers have been processed.
Get the server name from the current row of the serverTable.
Check if the ping was successful.
Send an email to the administrator if the server is down.
Display a message indicating the server is up.
